description: List the seller's conversations with buyers across every connected marketplace and store, newest first. Each has a `ref` that get_buyer_conversation and reply_to_buyer take. Needs the buyer support add-on.

channel.description: Only this channel; list_channels returns the ids. Omit for all.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 30, max 100.

waiting.description: True = only conversations where the buyer wrote last and nobody has answered.

name: list_buyer_conversations
